summary.business_type: Travel Guide / Content Publisher (SEO-first information site)
top_findings: Missing canonical tags on all 9 pages — duplicate content risk
No author bylines, about page, or E-E-A-T trust signals
Missing schema types: WebSite, Organization, BreadcrumbList
No social share image (og-default.png doesn't exist)
No on-page photography — travel content without images
quick_wins: Add self-referencing canonical tags to BaseLayout (10 min)
Add WebSite + Organization JSON-LD schema to homepage (15 min)
Add font-display: swap to Google Fonts link (1 min)
Create a simple OG image (30 min)
Add AI crawler directives to robots.txt (5 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt present and correctly configured
XML sitemap valid with 8 URLs and appropriate priorities
Clean URL structure throughout
Mobile responsive with viewport meta and Tailwind responsive utilities
Astro SSG delivers full content in initial HTML — no JS dependency for indexing

findings.title: Missing canonical tags on all pages
findings.description: No <link rel='canonical'> tag exists in BaseLayout or any page. This exposes the site to duplicate content issues from URL variations, www vs non-www, and parameter-based URLs.
findings.recommendation: Add a self-referencing canonical tag to the BaseLayout <head> that Astro generates per-page.

findings.title: No www/non-www redirect
findings.description: No 301 redirect is configured between www and non-www versions. Both could be indexed simultaneously, splitting link equity.
findings.recommendation: Configure a 301 redirect from one version to the other at the hosting/CDN level.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: No CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers are set. Security is a trust signal Google considers in ranking.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via Astro middleware or hosting config (Netlify/Vercel/Cloudflare).

findings.title: No AI crawler directives in robots.txt
findings.description: robots.txt has no rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, or PerplexityBot. Without directives, all AI bots crawl freely.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit AI crawler rules based on your content strategy (allow browsing, optionally block training).

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.description: Bing, Yandex, and Naver support IndexNow for instant indexing notifications. Currently not configured.
findings.recommendation: Generate an IndexNow key and add ping logic to the build pipeline.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage content is rich, engaging, and demonstrates genuine first-hand travel experience
FAQ page is comprehensive with 12 well-structured questions
Monthly guide provides granular, data-backed recommendations per month
Content is unique, substantive, and reader-focused — no keyword stuffing
Readability is excellent with varied sentence structure and conversational tone

findings.title: No author bylines or credentials anywhere
findings.description: No page identifies who wrote the content. For travel advice (a YMYL-adjacent topic), Google expects visible authorship. The trust section claims firsthand experience but doesn't name anyone.
findings.recommendation: Add author bylines with bios. Create an About page with credentials and methodology.

findings.title: Missing 'Who / How / Why' signals
findings.description: Google's helpful content heuristic asks who created the content, how it was created, and why. None of these are visible. The trust section mentions data sources but doesn't cite them specifically.
findings.recommendation: Add author bios, a methodology section explaining data sources, and make the site's purpose explicit.

findings.title: No about, contact, or legal pages
findings.description: Missing /about/, /contact/, privacy policy, and terms of service pages. These are baseline trust signals for both users and search engines.
findings.recommendation: Create an About page, a simple contact page, and a privacy policy page.

findings.title: Static copyright/update dates
findings.description: The copyright year and 'Updated Jul 2026' are hardcoded. If not actively updated, dates will become stale, signaling neglect.
findings.recommendation: Use Astro's build-time date injection or add a CMS-backed lastmod mechanism.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 9 pages have unique, keyword-rich title tags (50-70 char)
All pages have unique, compelling meta descriptions (120-160 char)
Every page has exactly one H1 aligned with title intent
Logical heading hierarchy (H1→H2→H3) throughout
Excellent internal linking — nav, footer, and contextual CTAs

findings.title: Homepage H1 could incorporate year or differentiator
findings.description: 'Best Time to Visit China' is keyword-rich but could include '2026' or a unique angle to better differentiate from competitors.
findings.recommendation: Consider 'Best Time to Visit China in 2026' in the visible H1 (already in the title tag).

findings.title: Subpages lack secondary keyword targeting in headings
findings.description: While primary keywords are covered, subpages don't target complementary queries in H2/H3 headings (e.g., /festivals/ could include 'Chinese New Year travel tips').
findings.recommendation: Audit each subpage for secondary keyword opportunities in subheadings.

findings.title: No visible lastmod dates on content pages
findings.description: Only the homepage has a freshness indicator. Content pages benefit from visible update dates for user trust and crawl prioritization.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Last updated' timestamps to key content pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Homepage includes basic Article JSON-LD schema
All pages use valid JSON-LD format

findings.title: Only one schema type exists across entire site
findings.description: Only the homepage has schema markup. The 8 subpages carry no structured data at all, missing opportunities for rich results and entity resolution.
findings.recommendation: Add appropriate schema to every page: Article for guides, QAPage for FAQ, BreadcrumbList site-wide.

findings.title: Missing WebSite and Organization schema
findings.description: No WebSite (with SearchAction) or Organization schema exists. These are foundational for Sitelinks Search Box and Knowledge Graph eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite schema to homepage with SearchAction. Add Organization schema with name, url, and logo.

findings.title: Article schema missing key properties
findings.description: Homepage Article schema lacks datePublished, dateModified, mainEntityOfPage, and image properties — all recommended for rich result eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add datePublished, dateModified, mainEntityOfPage, and image to the Article schema.

findings.title: FAQ page lacks QAPage schema
findings.description: While FAQPage rich results are retired (May 2026), QAPage schema still aids AI Overview and AI search entity resolution.
findings.recommendation: Add QAPage schema to the /faq/ page with individual Question/Answer items.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Astro SSG delivers full static HTML — excellent LCP potential
Tailwind CSS with Vite tree-shaking for minimal CSS
No render-blocking third-party scripts or ad networks
React islands use client:visible for deferred hydration

findings.title: OG image file missing
findings.description: BaseLayout references /og-default.png as social share image, but no such file exists. Every social share will appear without a preview image.
findings.recommendation: Create og-default.png (1200x630px) in the public/ directory.

findings.title: Google Fonts loads synchronously without display=swap
findings.description: The Google Fonts stylesheet can block text rendering (FOIT). Missing display=swap parameter.
findings.recommendation: Add &display=swap to the Google Fonts URL. Better: self-host Geist fonts.

findings.title: Scroll-reveal animations may contribute to CLS
findings.description: The .reveal class uses opacity:0 + translateY without reserving layout space. As elements become visible on scroll, layout may shift.
findings.recommendation: Reserve space with min-height or use will-change + contain-intrinsic-size.

findings.title: React island bundle size
findings.description: React + Recharts adds ~95KB gzipped for chart islands. Consider if charts could be rendered server-side for users who don't interact.
findings.recommendation: Explore Astro's server-islands or static SVG charts as fallback.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Well-structured content with clear sections and data-rich tables
FAQ page provides natural Q&A structure for AI extraction
Clean semantic HTML aids machine readability

findings.title: No Organization schema for entity resolution
findings.description: Without Organization markup, AI systems cannot resolve your site as a named entity, limiting appearance in AI-generated recommendations and citations.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD schema with name, url, logo, and description.

findings.title: No author attribution for AI citations
findings.description: AI systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity) increasingly cite named authors. Anonymous content is less likely to surface as a trustworthy source.
findings.recommendation: Add author bylines with Person schema linked to Article schema.

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: The emerging llms.txt standard gives AI systems a curated index of your content. Not having one misses AI search discovery opportunities.
findings.recommendation: Create an llms.txt at the site root with summaries of each page.

findings.title: No explicit AI crawler strategy
findings.description: All AI crawlers have unrestricted access. Consider whether you want to allow GPTBot/ClaudeBot training or only browsing.
findings.recommendation: Add AI crawler rules to robots.txt based on your content strategy.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Favicon provided in both .ico and .svg formats

findings.title: No on-page images anywhere on the site
findings.description: The entire site is text-only with CSS-decorated cards. Travel content without photography severely limits engagement, shareability, and perceived quality.
findings.recommendation: Add destination photos, seasonal imagery, and festival photos to key pages. Travel content is inherently visual.

findings.title: Missing OG social share image
findings.description: /og-default.png doesn't exist. Social shares have no preview image, reducing click-through from social media and messaging apps.
findings.recommendation: Create og-default.png (1200x630px) immediately. Consider unique OG images per page.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add self-referencing canonical tags to BaseLayout
Configure www/non-www redirect at hosting level
Add WebSite + Organization JSON-LD schema to homepage
Create og-default.png social share image (1200x630px)
Add display=swap to Google Fonts URL or self-host fonts

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add author bylines and Person schema to all content pages
Create About page with credentials, methodology, and data sources
Create Contact page and Privacy Policy page
Add BreadcrumbList schema site-wide
Add QAPage schema to /faq/ page
Add datePublished/dateModified to Article schema
Add security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
Add AI crawler directives to robots.txt

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add destination and seasonal photography throughout the site
Create dedicated landing pages for high-value long-tail queries
Add secondary keyword targeting to subpage headings
Create llms.txt file for AI search discovery
Implement IndexNow for Bing/Yandex indexing
Add visible lastmod dates to content pages
Research and acquire backlinks from travel blogs and China tourism sites

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console and monitor index coverage
Set up Bing Webmaster Tools for non-Google search visibility
Monitor Core Web Vitals in CrUX and optimize as needed
Track keyword rankings for target queries
A/B test OG images for social share click-through
Regularly update weather data and festival dates for freshness
Consider self-hosting fonts for faster LCP
